title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England files for review and approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy a 365-Day Firm Transportation Service Agreement with Fidelity Corporate Real Estate LLC.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department also finds thet the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul G. Afonso, Chairman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating and Judith F. Judson. (D.T.E. 05-GC-14)
